name: c1_mqar__pf__1M__s0__N100000
optimizer: AdamW betas (0.9, 0.98) weight decay 0.1, grad clip 1.0, warmup max_steps/20, cosine to 10%
position: none (read heads over the tape; recurrence over steps)

pf.read_gradient: straight-through weighted sum of the 6 candidate reads

judgment_checkpoint: highest in-distribution accuracy (earliest if tied); out-of-distribution at it
accuracy: MQAR: per-query accuracy of the answers a_i (primary, 'acc'; also used for early stop and the judgment checkpoint) and whole-sequence accuracy (secondary, 'acc_seq'); teacher-forced
